observations.activeWork: Sustained positive processCPU, especially>=0.5core average in a valid30s window, with per-thread CPU growth/runnable observations and later native stage/semantic progress supports active computation. Positive I/O counters with corresponding elapsed changes supports observed I/O work. This does not identify a managed hotspot or prove all work is necessary.
observations.waiting: A valid>=30s window with<=0.05core average, little I/O progress and repeatedly sleeping tasks/stable wait channels supports observed waiting. futex or leader wchan alone does not prove deadlock, lock ownership or a product defect; an async main thread may sleep while workers compute. observations.environmentCpuConstraint: Compare dated cpu.max/cpu.stat deltas with target duty/runnable samples. Sustained near-quota cgroup usage, increasingnr_throttled/throttled_usec concurrent with runnable target and low scheduling progress supports resource pressure in that interval. Cgroup counters include other processes and cannot retroactively explain frozen runs; aggregate counters/current snapshots are insufficient.
observations.environmentMemoryConstraint: Concurrent memory.current near capturedmemory.max and increases in memory.events high/max/oom/oom_kill, plus targetRSS/fault changes, supports observed memory constraint. An oom_kill delta is strong resource-fault evidence but still requires attribution; highRSS or cumulative pre-run events alone is insufficient.
observations.ioWait: TaskD/io-related wait channels together with dated processI/O deltas can support I/O delay. Flat /procIO may mean cache activity; lack of a counter is a gap, not zero. This does not prove a particular managed wait/lock.
observations.unresolved: Ambiguous/missing critical-window accounting, insufficient stable identity coverage, contradictory patterns, or a native timeout with no unique source/ownership cause remains a bounded blocker. Do not name an unproved product defect or infer no case ran from noTRX/zero summary counts.

postRunJointVerdict: Proved defect: link actual failure/trace to exact source/ownership violation, propose only a narrow remedy with independent affected SOURCE/PREP; preserve originals. CPU/wchan alone cannot establish it.

Justified environment budget: quantify actual observed work/CPU/wall/cleanup and sampling uncertainty; distinguish child from category aggregate. Give a finite proposed bound and separate performancehold, preserving original outcomes. Any changed budget requires its own reviewed source/preparation and new qualification; no57/count advancement from diagnostics or budget alone. Do not claim fivecase duration from cut1 alone.

Bounded blocker: state the exact missing proof or environment limit and the next distinct action/decision needed. End this diagnostic chain; no automatic same-run repeat, new profiler or product instrumentation without a newly discriminating observation/authority.
